layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of tropical island lagoons
features: Low cliffs of pale limestone rock
Sunlight illuminating the rippled sandy floor through the water
layer_3_action.action: A bright tropical paradise at noon. The water is so clear it looks like glass, and the sun highlights the white sand and grey rock.

visuals.ground: Pure white sand and pale grey limestone. Vegetation is sparse, consisting of small, tough ferns and Cycads. No grass.
visuals.water: Extremely clear turquoise water with gentle white-capped ripples, reflecting the brilliant white sun.
visuals.sky: Brilliant, cloudless blue sky; high-noon clarity.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Coarse carbonate sand and sun-bleached limestone edges.

negative_prompt: grass, lawns, dense forest, gloom, swamp, night, 90s CGI, grainy, humans, buildings
